NONE: › the action of tearing away a part of the body as a result of an accident or surgery
（因意外事故或外科手術，身體一部分的）撕脫，抽出
› friendly, kind, or helpful, like the expected behaviour of an uncle
叔伯般的；慈祥的；關懷備至的

example: 慈祥和善、談吐溫和的男子
His avuncular image belies his steely determination.
他慈祥的外貌和他堅強的意志形成鮮明的對照。
